name: Dust
description: "All things fade in time. Before the wielders of the Path of Dust, no wall remains forever unbroken, and no tree grows unto the sky."

abilities.name: The Hollowing
abilities.description: Ritual (2 Soul, Camp Action) transforms non-Soft Body corpse into Husk.

abilities.name: Army of Dust
abilities.description: Control Husks equal to Dust Rank (excess cost 2 Notches). Released Husks become mundane corpses. Uncontrolled Husks attack non-Barren/non-Dust creatures.

abilities.name: Living Death
abilities.description: Created Husks move naturally, can pass as normal bugs (-1 Speed, no Creep bonus). Requires 3 Insight successes to identify as Husk.

abilities.name: Allegiance
abilities.description: When controlled Husk damages target in melee, gain 1 Soul (max 1 Soul/Husk/round).

abilities.name: Hollow Wind
abilities.description: Create Husk from adjacent corpse as Focus action (instead of Camp Action).

abilities.name: Hollow Graves
abilities.description: If bug within Close range dies from/under Dust Spell (Difficulty 2+), may immediately turn into Husk at no cost.
